Card Q&A.a: This effect prevents digivolution costs from being reduced when the costs are to be paid. This effect affects the opponent player.
Card Q&A.q: What does a "your opponent can't reduce digivolution costs" effect do, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be digivolved. "Digivolve without paying the cost" effects aren't effects that reduce the digivolution cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can my opponent digivolve a card using a "digivolve without paying the cost" effect while a "your opponent can't reduce digivolution costs" effect is activated?

Effect: [Opponent's Turn] Your opponent can't reduce digivolution costs.
